_comment: List the MCP servers the agent should connect to. Each server's tools become real tools the LLM can call with LLM-generated arguments -- only add servers you trust. The 'demo' entry below runs the bundled mcp_demo_server.py (stdio, no network) so this works out of the box with zero setup.
_comment_remote_example: For a real external server: {"my_server": {"transport": "streamable_http", "url": "https://example.com/mcp", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}}} or {"transport": "sse", "url": "..."}
